trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment your 54th other trophy unlocks, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then partners and strangers, then activities, collectibles and the crime counts, and finish with 100% Completion. If you keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, the platinum lands with A Long Road and you are done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the game, so play through it and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed: it pops the first time you finish the mission. If you are already past the opening, it is already in your collection.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full and the trophy pops at the chapter-ending cutscene. This is story progress, so it unlocks automatically as you play and there is no way to skip past it. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway, in case you ever want to revisit it, and do Lucia’s balcony meditation before the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter’s final mission. Like every chapter trophy, it arrives on its own as long as you keep playing the story in order, and it cannot be missed. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter so you always have a way back.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 and the trophy pops at the chapter’s final mission. It is a story trophy, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the story in order and it cannot be missed. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, as you should for every chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter’s last mission ends. It is part of the normal story path, so it cannot be missed and needs no special preparation. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter, and another before the final mission that follows it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game and this gold trophy pops as the credits begin. It unlocks as long as you finish the story, so it cannot be missed. Make a manual save before the final mission, because the game has no mission replay, and that save is your safety net if you ever want to revisit the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is on the main story path, so it cannot be missed and needs no preparation. If you have already finished the story, it is already earned.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy pops at the end of the mission. It is a story trophy on the normal story path, so it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. Just keep playing the story in order.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child’s Play and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is part of the main story, so it cannot be missed and needs no special steps. If you have finished the story, it is already in your collection.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is on the main story path, so it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. Just keep playing the story in order.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is part of the main story, so it cannot be missed and needs no preparation. If you have finished the story, it is already earned.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops at the end of the mission. It is a story trophy on the normal story path, so it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. Keep playing the story in order and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion by finishing every story mission, every partner and stranger strand, all activities, collectibles and counts in the game, then check the stats screen for 100%. This is the last trophy most players earn: the roadmap’s earlier stages cover every requirement, so treat this as the final check. When the stats screen reads 100%, the trophy pops and the platinum follows.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts count when you land jumps, near-misses and other stunt actions while driving or riding, so the counter builds up naturally over the whole playthrough and you should not grind it early. By the end of the story and the collectible sweeps most players are close; finish it by chaining jumps off ramps in free roam.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one round of every activity the game offers — shooting range, drone races, regular races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the rest — and the trophy pops when you have sampled them all. You do not need to win or earn a gold medal in anything, just try each type once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has a score threshold for gold, so practice the weapon handling, aim for headshots and controlled bursts, and replay a challenge as many times as needed. Gold medals are per challenge, so you can clear them one at a time in any order.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There is a drone race at each Top Fun location across Leonida, and you need to win one race at each of them. Learn the course on the first attempt, then fly the racing line cleanly; the trophy pops after the last location’s win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are found around Leonida — street races, off-road and others — and each distinct race you win counts once. Win 20 different ones and the trophy pops; replays of a race you already won do not add to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal’s fishing challenge, then out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel steadily and do not let the fish snap the line. The trophy pops when the challenge ends with you ahead.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick any game and play it through to the end — finishing one game is enough. It is one of the quickest trophies in the guide and a good first step for the activity stage.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy’s missions unlock as you progress; finish his whole strand and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission. Partner strands stay open after the story, so you can finish them in free roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton’s strand to its final mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Partner strands stay open after the story, so finish them in free roam if needed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy’s whole strand and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission. Partner strands stay open after the story, so you can finish them in free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons around the map, so work through eight full strands to their conclusions. They stay open after the story, so you can finish them in free roam; the trophy pops when the eighth strand ends.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy’s whole strand and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission. Partner strands stay open after the story, so finish them in free roam if needed.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone’s strand to its final mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Partner strands stay open after the story, so you can finish them in free roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — there are 18 spots. Lucia’s balcony meditation in Chapter 1 is the one that can be missed: it is only available during that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so do it before Chapter 1 ends. The other spots stay available in free roam; the trophy pops when the last spot is meditated at.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret’s hunting strand asks for a specific unique animal, so track it with the hunting tools, take the shot cleanly and bring it back. The trophy pops when the hunt is complete.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, so collect a full set of cards to complete it, and do that for three sets. Use the map markers in the linked guides and sweep region by region so you do not miss a card.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app marks photo spots around Leonida, so visit 100 of them and take the photo at each one. The counter builds up as you explore, so work it into the region sweeps for the other collectibles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game’s side objectives — races, stunts, hunting and more — and each completed challenge counts. Work through the challenge list in the pause menu and finish 50 of them; the trophy pops at the fiftieth.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. The trophy pops when the heat is off and you are both free.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob a shop, then immediately rob a second and a third without the wanted level dropping or the police catching you. Keep the getaway car close and move fast between shops — the trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles you get into for the first time count as discovered, so drive or ride 100 different vehicles across Leonida. The counter builds naturally over the whole playthrough; finish it by visiting car parks, docks and garages for models you have not driven yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with five enemies in range, then take them all down before the meter runs out. Set it up in a busy firefight — a gang hideout or a police standoff — where five targets are close together.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, take a vehicle — or a plane — and leave the airport in a way the schedule never intended. The trophy pops when the departure registers, so expect a wanted level and have a getaway ready.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it — the trophy is tied to using the tank’s firepower. Find a Rhino at a military site, take it, and the trophy pops once you have used it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, enter quietly and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted — use stealth, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. The trophy pops when you escape undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are found in banks around Leonida, so crack one, take the cash and escape the police response. Do it five times and the trophy pops after the fifth clean getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the police. The trophy pops once you have escaped cleanly.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region and point of interest on the map — the whole state, from Vice City to the swamps and the keys. The trophy pops when the last undiscovered area is revealed; sweep the map in the free-roam stage and check for grey, unexplored corners.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida, so hit one operation for every gang. The trophy pops once you have robbed an operation from each of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops when the moment registers. It is one of the quietest trophies in the list, so save it for a calm moment between jobs.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom’s glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. The trophy pops when the smash is complete, so expect a wanted level and a repair bill.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley, play a game and follow through to the end — the trophy pops when the game finishes. It pairs naturally with Ten Pin, which is also a bowling trophy, so do both in the same visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The exact trigger for this trophy is not yet confirmed — it appears to be tied to a partnership activity in the game, likely a story or side strand. Check the linked guides for the latest confirmed steps, and do not grind blindly: the community is still pinning this one down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This trophy appears to be tied to a story choice, but the trigger is not yet confirmed, so it may unlock through a decision in a specific mission. Play the story normally and check the linked guides for the confirmed trigger before replaying anything; the game has no mission replay, so keep manual saves.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time’s the charm. The trigger is not yet confirmed — the name suggests a second attempt at something, likely a failed-then-retried event. Check the linked guides for the latest confirmed steps rather than guessing, and keep manual saves around any event that looks like it could be the one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is not yet confirmed — it sounds like a hidden event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. Check the linked guides for the latest confirmed location or event, and do not chase it blindly: the community is still pinning this one down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, perform a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock the pins, or the bowlers, over. It pairs with Let’s Go Bowling, so do both in the same visit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so launder them through your contacts a little at a time until $250,000 has been cleaned. The counter is cumulative, so it builds up over the whole crime stage.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, vehicles and upgrades until $100,000 has been spent in total — the counter is cumulative across every shop in the game. It builds naturally over the playthrough; finish it by buying the expensive items you want anyway.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available around Leonida — each one costs money, so save up during the crime stage. The trophy pops when the last garage is purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — ten different registrations and the trophy pops. Register vehicles as you discover them for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.
